mapper.sql: id, user_id as userId, title, content, status, priority, due_date as dueDate, category, finish_time as finishTime, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime
mapper.update:
UPDATE todoTask SET
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
priority = #{priority},
due_date = #{dueDate},
category = #{category},
update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM todoTask WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT status as key, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '待完成' WHEN 1 THEN '已完成' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END as text, COUNT(1) as count FROM todoTask WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status
SELECT priority as key, CASE priority WHEN 0 THEN '低' WHEN 1 THEN '中' WHEN 2 THEN '高' ELSE '未知' END as text, COUNT(1) as count FROM todoTask WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY priority
SELECT category as key, category as text, COUNT(1) as count FROM todoTask WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category != '' GROUP BY category
SELECT id, title, due_date as dueDate, priority FROM todoTask WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND due_date BETWEEN #{now} AND #{expireTime} ORDER BY priority DESC, dueDate ASC
